status: current agreed contract; atomic implementation cutover tracked in #367/#370
schema_kind: Descriptive Arrow contract, not a JSON instance-validation schema
maintenance: Normative 0.0.7 contract. The legacy protocol_schema.py generator is not yet migrated to this file.
source_adapter_exception: Unversioned upstream FHC params are accepted by an explicit adapter; declared older trd versions are not upgraded.

params.row_model: one existing scene sample; sparse video rows are not padded

tracked_fhc.matrix_order: row-major model on wire; column-major internally
tracked_fhc.point: struct<x: float32 not null, y: float32 not null, w: float32 not null, h: float32 not null>
tracked_fhc.intrinsics: struct<fx: float32 not null, fy: float32 not null, cx: float32 not null, cy: float32 not null, skew: float32 not null, w: float32 not null, h: float32 not null>

columns.name: bottom_quads
columns.arrow_type: list<fixed_size_list<point not null, 4> not null> not null

columns.name: model
columns.arrow_type: list<fixed_size_list<fixed_size_list<float32 not null, 4> not null, 4> not null> not null

columns.name: mesh_id
columns.constraint: explicit bindings required when implicit correspondence is ambiguous

constraints: Preserve source corner order and winding; never clamp finite off-image quads.
Use each source point/intrinsics width and height for FHC conversion.
Per-placement lists align and consumed geometry/model values are finite.
Preserve existing CG/CV camera defaults and golden camera values.
Do not mix CG and CV camera forms.

mesh.row_model: one immutable asset per unique UUID
constraints: Valid self-contained GLB with no external buffers/images.
Resource row reordering does not change UUID bindings.
No re-encoding or stripping original GLB bytes on export.

editing.scope: selected object across all corresponding existing sparse rows
editing.identity: track_id across reorder/gaps, otherwise consistent ordered instance/binding list; reject ambiguity
editing.replay: read saved per-row models without reapplying authoring adjustments
